z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Monolith Beetle
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.visual_theme: Grounded beetle with a stone/monument visual cue.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Fits Z9's monument and celestial-weather finale as a relic-associated insect.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Beetle is an ordinary garden/grass-edge creature and its grounded silhouette fits village outskirts.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: HIGH: familiar insect ecology plus a clear grounded silhouette; not based on size alone.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Starsand Wolf
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.visual_theme: Terrestrial wolf with a star-sand accent.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Fits Z9's star and sky-fauna language.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Wolf is a familiar terrestrial animal that can fit grassland or village-edge ecology.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: HIGH: familiar terrestrial predator and grassland ecology, with the star cue retained as the main cost.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Thundercrown Stag
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.visual_theme: Stag/grazer with storm and crown motifs.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Strong Z9 fit through storm, crown and celestial-grazer language.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Stag and grazer identity directly fits grassland, woodland edge and ordinary early fauna.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: HIGH: familiar grazer ecology and readable woodland identity; the name remains elevated.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Skydrum Tortoise
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.visual_theme: Grounded tortoise with a sky/drum motif.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Fits Z9's storm and sky-fauna set.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Grounded tortoise can fit a stream, grass or village-outskirts ecology.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: HIGH: familiar grounded reptile and stream-edge ecology; not justified only by readability.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Dawnwing Serpent
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Fits Z9's dawn and aerial-serpent imagery.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Serpent can fit grass or small-stream ecology, but the wing cue weakens the fit.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: MEDIUM_HIGH: familiar serpent ecology, offset by aerial styling.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Starshard Rhino
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name_theme: Starshard; explicit celestial and endgame rarity signal.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Fits Z9's starshard and mythic fauna language.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Rhino is terrestrial, but its heavy elite-normal identity is a poor village-edge fit.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: MEDIUM: familiar animal identity, but mass and elite framing conflict with ordinary early ecology.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Riftbow Eagle
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.visual_theme: Aerial eagle with rift/bow and storm motifs.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Strong Z9 storm and sky-fauna fit.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Eagle is familiar wild fauna, but aerial/rift identity conflicts with simple village-edge ecology.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: MEDIUM: familiar species, but aerial dramatic identity dominates.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Thundercrystal Mantis
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Strong Z9 elemental and crystal-storm fit.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Mantis can fit garden ecology, but the thundercrystal treatment is too strongly late-game.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: MEDIUM_HIGH: familiar garden insect, outweighed by elemental identity conflict.

z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.name: Skyvault Whale
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.current_z9_fit: Very strong Z9 sky and mythic-scale fit.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.target_z1_fit: Whale and skyvault scale do not fit village outskirts, grassland or small-stream content.
z9_to_z1_eligible_candidates.readability: LOW: identity is legible but not compatible with ordinary early ecology.
